tweets.text:
For those who’ve forgotten some of @LindseyGrahamSC criticisms of @realDonaldTrump here are just a few examples :

1) Called President Trump a “race-baiting, xenophobic, religious bigot”, 
- Interview on CNN’s New Day in December 2015. 

2) Told Trump to “go to hell”, 
- Came from same CNN appearance, where he was pushing hard against Trump’s campaign vibe. 

3) Syria withdrawal being a disaster.
- From comments he made around October 2019, tied to Trump’s move to pull troops out of northern Syria.

4) Gaza displacement and January 6 pardons.
- Graham was on CNN talking about how he didn’t like Trump pardoning folks who “attacked cops” and disagreed with displacing Palestinians. 

5) Commented on Bolton and Pompeo protection 
- Newsweek article where he called out Trump’s first-week moves as mistakes. 

6) Graham said Trump technically broke the law w certain Inspector General items
- Mentioned the legal breach on CNN

7) Wasn’t too keen on backing Tulsi Gabbard
- Face the Nation interview

My guess is I could find a ton of other negative things Graham has said about @POTUS 

Fox News loves him especially Hannity.  Enough said there.

Graham is a wishy washy neocon RINO w no spine and IDGAF if President Trump supports him still.

We are allowed to disagree on things.
